$comment: The cabin at Lake Quinault (BUILD_PLAN S7; GAME_DESIGN 2.2, 11.11, 12.3): one authored file read two ways. Its next table compiles into data/rules.json as the section home (rules, hashed); everything else compiles into art/art.json as cabin (display data, with the plate and its stamps), both only on a channel with the home screen. plate: the hand-drawn 160x320 plate (content/art/pics/home/), August (season), its anchors (Z at_<name> ops) and its places' Z ops (art boxes) the record of where things are drawn; tables: the table each hour resolves with, the cabin's own (remaps: the shared tables of web/js/gfx/palette.js with the cabin's changes; dawn borrows dusk's, GAME_DESIGN 11.4); skies, weather, lights, embers, smoke and states: the stamps web/js/gfx/cabin.js composes over the plate, each at an anchor (or the plate's origin) on its layer, in this order (a far or mid weather stamp whose anchor the plate sets on that layer is drawn at the anchor's place in the plate's draw order, so the plate says what stands in front of it: the low fog lies behind the maples and the shed); moon: the real moon's arithmetic (lead call 54) and its stamps; stars: how many twinkle at blue hour and at night, above at_star_floor, plus the Big Dipper's seven, fixed; quiet: the name's quiet sky, where no star, moon or rain goes (S7b); places: each place's kind (place, look, silent, first), art box and hit area (picture pixels; lint P17 holds every hit area to 44 x 44 pt on every phone), label anchor (the label's top edge's center, or with align right its top right corner: ui/cabin.js labelBox; P17 keeps the labels inside the plate and apart on every phone, so the fire bowl's sits under the bowl and the mailbox's over the mailbox), rail button, the screen it opens and the session that lands it; rail: the porch rail's order; hours: the rule that turns the sun table into the cabin's hour (platform/now.js hourAt); sky: the climatology's knobs (platform/now.js skyOn), fog's odds flagged estimates until T2's forecast; next: the next-step button's states, each with the session that lands it; first: the porch frame's window on the plate (ui/porch.js). schemas/cabin.schema.json is its J01.

remaps.$comment: The cabin's own tables (the S7 art director's second round): the shared tables of web/js/gfx/palette.js (11.4), each named for its base, with these slots changed and no other (test/unit/cabin.test.mjs holds each change), so the trail's pictures never move. The vapour: night navy (1) and alpenglow pink (6) are never drawn as themselves on the cabin (a test holds it); the smoke (cycle 29) and the fog draw in them, the vapour's shade (1) and its light (6), and each hour sends them where smoke and fog belong, a step lighter than what they cross and never pink: glacier blue and snow by day, at dusk and at dawn (the morning fog is white and the summit floats on it, while the peak's own snow goes alpenglow pink); slate and glacier blue at blue hour and night. Dusk (and dawn): paper cream (5: the path, the chalk, the dry grass's tips) goes to sage, not pink, so the alpenglow stays on the peak's snow and the horizon; and bark (10) goes to ink, not bark, so the battens stay a step below the boards (brick going to bark) and the board-and-batten gable never resolves to one flat brown (the S7 art director's third round), as blue hour already has it. Blue hour: the meadow and the maples (moss 13 and sage 14) go to forest, not teal, so the ground stands under the sky, and paper cream to teal, not slate, so the path and the dry grass still read on it. Night: the meadow and the maples go to spruce, not forest, so the lawn and the maples are night under a navy sky and the trees stand as dark shapes against the horizon's slate glow, and paper cream to forest, not teal, a quiet step above the lawn; the lit cabin, its spill and the embers carry the light.

moon.$comment: Lead call 54: the phase from the date by integer arithmetic, age in hundred-thousandths of a day since a fixed new moon (2000-01-06 18:14 UTC) modulo the synodic month (29.53059 days: synodic_e5, 2953059 hundred-thousandths), as eighths 0 (new, not drawn) to 7, lit on the right while waxing; it rises at 6:00 Pacific plus 48 minutes a day of age and is up for 12 hours, a plain rule, drawn at one fixed spot over the peak's left shoulder.

stars.$comment: Stars twinkle (the star cycle, 22) one pixel each, never two touching, never on or beside a fixed star, above at_star_floor, thinning toward the horizon; count is the whole sky's, and quiet.name takes its share (about half at night); seeded by the cabin (ART_SEED), so every phone sees the same sky. The Big Dipper's seven, fixed, right of the spruce's tip.

quiet.$comment: S7b, Lead call 69 (lead call 61's quiet sky for the name): name, [x, y, w, h] in picture pixels, the sky the cabin's name sits in, where web/js/gfx/cabin.js places no twinkling star (a star that falls there is left out, so the sky under it keeps its density: stars.count is the whole sky's) and where the Dipper, the moon and the rain never reach (test/unit/cabin.test.mjs). It is the name's line box (ui/cabin.js nameBox: 23 chrome glyphs at the frame's font pixel and the ink shadow's pixel under them, centered in rows 2 to 28 as home.css's .cabin-name sets it) at every room lint P17 lays the home out in, a character cell and a half (12 font pixels) either side along its line, so no star reads as its punctuation (the S7 shots' full stop after Hiker), one picture pixel out, up to row 0: on the SE's 4x2 the line is 138 columns, and a cell and a half either side reaches the plate's edges, so it is the whole band, rows 0 to 28 (P17 holds it at every room).

hours.$comment: platform/now.js hourAt: from the sun table's row [offset, civil dawn, sunrise, sunset, civil dusk], with A = sunrise - civil dawn and B = civil dusk - sunset: night until civil dawn - A x blue_outside; blue until civil dawn + A x blue_inside; dawn until sunrise + sun_margin; day; dusk from sunset - sun_margin; blue from sunset + B x blue_inside; night from civil dusk + B x blue_outside. The shares are per mille, so the rule stays integer.

sky.$comment: platform/now.js skyOn: the date's sky, one draw a date. Rain: the cabin zone's station's wet days (days with 0.01 in or more) over the month's days; cloudy: of the rest, the chain's unsettled share; clear otherwise. Morning fog: a second draw on a dry day against fog_permille, from blue hour to fog_until, flagged estimates until T2's forecast (lead call 64's note).
